name: comp-460
title: Pagination First Last
description: A flat numbered pager with first-page and previous chevrons before the page links, an ellipsis for skipped pages, and next and last chevrons after them in the code.
use: Long lists where people want to jump to the very start or end as well as step through pages.
avoid: When the row must fit a narrow column: the icon-heavy pager needs a wide container.
a11y: Every chevron has an aria-label including first and last, so names are clear; the hover fills have no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A flat row on black opens with a bar-and-chevron first glyph and a single back chevron, then pages 1 to 4 with 3 in a rounded grey box, then a three-dot ellipsis. The right-hand next and last glyphs sit outside the recorded crop.
behaves: Hovering a chevron or number lays a darker rounded fill behind it while the active page keeps its grey block. The demo's page never advances, so only the hover fills change.
customise: Pass currentPage, totalPages and the number of page slots; chevron icons, their order and styling are fixed in the file.
weight: light: A short row of page links and chevrons; only hover and active styling.
